definitions.explanation: Women's shoes with tall, narrow heels. A loanword from English 'high heel.' Usually used in the singular form even when referring to a pair.

examples.japanese: ハイヒール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧。
ハイヒール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{長時間|ちょうじかん}→長時間：10165_choujikan⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{疲|つか}れる→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
examples.english: Walking in high heels for a long time tires out your feet.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚式|けっこんしき}→結婚式：05493_kekkonshiki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{合|あ}わせて→合わせる：01872_awaseru⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧ハイヒール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{買|か}い→買う：00489_kau⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to buy new high heels to match the wedding.

notes:
Loanword from English 'high heel.' In Japanese, the singular form is typically used to refer to the pair.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ハイヒール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{履|は}く→履く：00700_haku⟧: put on / wear high heels
- ハイヒール⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{脱|ぬ}ぐ→脱ぐ：00518_nugu⟧: take off high heels
- ハイヒール⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{歩|ある}く→歩く：00538_aruku⟧: walk in high heels
- ⟦{高|たか}い→高い：00500_takai⟧ハイヒール: high-heeled shoes (with tall heels)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- パンプス: pumps — closed-toe heels, often with a lower heel
- ⟦ヒール→ヒール：28994_hiiru⟧: heel — informal short form; can refer to the heel itself or the shoe style
